## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
Rotation. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) with Tech outperformance concentrated in a few names; confirmers include Financials and Industrials strength, but major divergence across mega-caps warrants caution.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +6.48% | 1M: +22.97%) ABOVE TREND.  
Financials strong: C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND.  
Technology showing concentrated leadership: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Staples weak: KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -0.63%) BELOW TREND.  
Utilities weak: Utilities (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.98%) showing weakness.  
Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -4.85% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY, AMD (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +4.30%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION, MET (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION, MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -2.02% | 1M: +11.17%) CORRECTION, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND; watch AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY — major-cap divergences in AAPL, GOOGL, META, AVGO signal a MAJOR DIVERGENCE; watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but front-loaded: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND and ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND are leading while AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY and AAPL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: -1.29%) RECOVERY create headline-level divergence; Tech: 13/19 positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Broad strength and confirmation for rotation: C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +5.15% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +4.79% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND — Financials: 16/20 positive.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed defensive tone: MRK (1W: +6.05% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +2.38%) ABOVE TREND offset pockets of weakness like MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND — Healthcare: 10/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Financials and Materials exposure (C, JPM, FCX, NEM) given rotation and cyclical confirmation; monitor NVDA and ORCL for continued leadership but reduce exposure to names with mixed signals (AAPL, AVGO, META) until trend clarity returns; style: Growth/Momentum tilt with tactical rotation into cyclicals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY with negative news, TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Financials (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) — rotate into banks/fintechs; Materials (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) — commodity leverage.  
BEARISH: Consumer Staples (1W: -0.23% | 1M: +0.93%) and Utilities (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.98%) — defensive underperformance.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: watch a hold above the recent 1M highs to confirm continuation (ABOVE TREND extension).  
AAPL: watch for failure to reclaim 1M range as a sign of renewed downside (RECOVERY fragile).  
JPM: watch a clean continuation above last weekly breakout to confirm Financials leadership (ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
XOM (+50): XOM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +4.02%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming.  
ABBV (+55): ABBV (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +2.00%) ABOVE TREND — earnings-driven bullishness; price confirming.  
IBM (+50): IBM (1W: +2.80% | 1M: +1.20%) ABOVE TREND — upgrade-driven; price confirming.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
F (-85): Ford (F) (1W: -? | 1M: -?) — headline-negative (news-heavy); cross-check price action before re-entry (sentiment severe).  
TSLA (-60): TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION — negative narrative with price divergence.  
AVGO (-55): AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY — negative headlines but 1W bounce; this is a distribution/short-cover warning.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Growth/Momentum style.  
NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE across mega-caps (AAPL, GOOGL, META, AVGO) and bearish headlines on AVGO/BA/TSLA — watch for trend breaks and sentiment-driven reversals.
